messages:
eli: Quick announce  we just published redwood-quant-tools v0.5.0 to GitHub and PyPI. This one focuses on safer post-training quant flows + a small GUI for inspection. :tada:

release-bot: Release published: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-quant-tools/releases/tag/v0.5.0 

hana: High level: improved fallback for mixed-precision kernels, a model-inspector GUI (local only), and a CLI command `rq convert --safe-mode` that runs extra validation passes.

perf-bot: Benchmarks (internal): median inference cost reduction ~22% on 4-bit INT8 fallback paths for encoder-decoder models (measured on internal microbench). Add caveats in the notes.

eli: Yep, we'll include the perf number but with measurement caveats: measured on convai-like workloads, not quantized-for-speed production models.

ci-bot: CI: All checks passed for tag v0.5.0 (build 11455). Integration tests: conversion-smoke, inspector-ui, safe-mode 20 passed.

ops: Important ops note: the inspector GUI is explicitly local-only (no telemetry). We added a startup flag to force headless mode when running in CI.

hana: Security note: `--safe-mode` enables extra checksum and collation checks to avoid silent-corruption cases. Security reviewed it and we landed a small change to tighten temp-file handling.

security: Confirmed. No CVE warranted, tracking ticket INF-5012 created for follow-up hardening.

devrel: Community plans: thinking a short "Quant Lab" livestream + hands-on workshop next Thursday (45 min). Volunteers to demo the inspector GUI and the safe conversion flow?

eli: I can demo the safe conversion flow and show how `rq convert --safe-mode` logs validation failures.

hana: I'll demo the inspector GUI and the new visualization of weight distributions.

devrel: Great. I'll draft the event page and a short tutorial notebook. Also want a 1-line community blurb we can post to the forum and tweet.

eli: Draft blurb: "redwood-quant-tools v0.5.0 1: safer conversion flows and a local model inspector to help debug quantization issues. Join our Quant Lab next Thu for a live demo."

devrel: Perfect. Can someone drop a tiny CLI example we can paste into the announcement?

hana: CLI example for docs: ```
# safe convert with explicit target bits
rq convert ./model-dir --bits 4 --safe-mode --out ./model-4bit
# inspect weights locally
rq inspect ./model-4bit --ui
```

eli: Added that to the release notes. Also called out: older transformer forks may need a small key-map patch; conversion will error with instructions rather than silently producing bad models.

ops: Release artifacts: sdist & wheel on PyPI; docker test images pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/redwood-quant-tools:0.5.0; small inspector binary included.

devrel: Promo schedule: community post + forum thread at 11am PT tomorrow, livestream next Thu at 10am PT. Will ask marketing to amplify.

ci-bot: Note: nightly back-compat job scheduled for the next three nights to exercise quant conversions on older checkpoints. Reports will be posted to the release thread.

eli: Thanks everyone. If maintainers want to rehearse demos, ping me and I'll add a rehearsal slot this week. :rocket:
